reference.title: Determination of dextromethorphan metabolic phenotype by salivary analysis with a reference to genotype in Chinese patients receiving renal hemodialysis.
reference.abstract: Determination of dextromethorphan metabolic ratios in saliva is feasible in patients with renal failure requiring hemodialysis. All subjects in this study appeared to be "extensive metabolizer" phenotype for CYP2D6, and no poor metabolizer was identified. From the results with quinidine pretreatment, a metabolic ratio of 33 is suggested to be a tentative antimode for identification of poor metabolizers in patients with renal failure.
